title: Governed source assurance
purpose: Demonstrate reviewer-controlled source staging and basic, inspectable KNO-01 processing with correlated progress across the governed surfaces, using synthetic information only.

steps.description: Establish the bounded synthetic reviewer application session.
Ask the presentation surface to show the admitted scenario introduction.
Ask the reviewer workbench to resolve the synthetic engagement context.
Ask the reviewer workbench to show the component-owned source-intake controls.
Ask the reviewer workbench to show KNO-01 processing lifecycle and its bounded result.
Ask the Presentation surface to show read-only KNO-01 progress without gaining business control.
Confirm the correlated CNT-01 to KNO-01 sequence, safe evidence references and single terminal outcome in Operations.
Pause Director sequencing without changing component-owned state.
Stop the demonstration session and terminate synthetic bindings.
Reset component-owned disposable state and create a successor session.

limitations: Presentation progress is not business completion or compliance evidence.
KNO-01 processing is limited to digest verification, counts and a bounded safe preview; it is not RAG ingestion or semantic understanding.
Processing completion is not evidence-quality, compliance, legal, clinical or production assurance.
The source body remains inside the authorised CNT-01 and KNO-01 boundary and is not published in lifecycle events, general logs or Presentation.
Managed hosted use requires the reviewed OIDC, workload identity, Cloud KMS, HTTPS, expiry and teardown bindings.
Hosted operation remains supervised, activation-scoped and synthetic-only.
